show.description: A dramatic tale about a hospital mix-up that implants businessman Kabir’s sperm into a stranger, Jiya. As Jiya becomes pregnant, Kabir brings her home, sparking jealousy in his wife and chaos in the Khanna family. Amid betrayal, greed, and emotional turmoil, an unexpected love begins to grow between Kabir and Jiya. Watch now.
